caseName: Greenholtz v. Inmates of the Nebraska Penal & Correctional Complex
caseNameFull: Greenholtz, Chairman, Board of Parole of Nebraska v. Inmates of the Nebraska Penal and Correctional Complex

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 817.] Motion of respondents for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Brian K. Ridenour, Esquire, of Lincoln, Neb., be appointed to serve as counsel in this case.
